runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted across to the tail of the field from gate 13, swung wide for a run at the home straight, rushed home despite laying in.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，切入居尾列。直路上向外移出取位。儘管內閃，但末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Held up in last pair from wide draw, still in rear entering home straight, hung right, little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後留居最後兩位之內。入直路時仍居後列。內閃，無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat midfield 3 wide, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) In last few after beginning from the widest barrier, jockey reported lost use of iron briefly, improved steadily in back straight to reach midfield 4-wide onto home bend, even wider turning in for home, soon weakened on straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 自大外檔出閘後居最後數位之內。騎師報告，他的左腳曾脫出腳踏。對面直路上穩步上前，開始轉直路彎時進佔中間位置，走第四疊。入直路時走更外疊，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W4W) Towards rear, taken wide bend, hung right under pressure, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W4W) 居後列。直路彎移出外疊。在催策下內閃，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Ridden along from widest draw to lead, joined 700m out, under pressure to hold position 400m out, gave ground quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策，領放。七百米處被追及。四百米處受催策以保持位置。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield early, found rail after entering the back straight, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，早段居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。進入對面直路後移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。入直路後固守內疊。衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Sat near the rear on the rail, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Broke fairly and settled midfield the rail, stayed at the same pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內欄。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Waited with in rear, checked 350m out, passed a few tiring rivals, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。三百五十米處勒避。超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 400M, taken wide in straight and made good progress to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Tracked pace, rail position, ridden to chase leader 350m out, no extra 150m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。三百五十米處在催策下追趕領放馬。一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, angled out 550M, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。中段搶口。五百五十米處向外移出。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W3W) Badly crowded shortly after start, settled in rear of mid-field, had to wait for run until 250m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W3W) 起步後不久嚴重受擠迫，居中間之後位置。須等待空位出現直至二百五十米處。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden along 600m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in last few 3-wide with cover, widest runner turning in for home, ran on steadily under pressure down the centre of the straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居最後數位之內，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時走最外疊。直路上受催策，在跑道中央以穩勢上前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Mid-division, three wide, pushed along halfway and struggling to hold position, soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。半程時受推策，難以保持位置，瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Prominent early, caught behind weakening runner from halfway and shuffled back to rear by top of home straight, no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 早段居前列。自半程起在轉弱的對手之後受困，直路初前墮居後列。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W4W) Held up, pushed along 300m out and no impression, never out of rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W4W) 留後。三百米處受推策，毫無表現。從未超越後列。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, weakened gradually, no impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置。逐漸轉弱。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat last, made some minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on at the one pace under pressure final 200m, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。最後二百米在催策下保持同速，從未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield, traveled fairly, crowded near the 150M, found nothing thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走勢一般。接近一百五十米處時受擠迫。其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat at the rear, no clear running until final furlong, made good late ground before held up in the concluding stages. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列。未能望空直至二百米處。末段追前甚多，其後受困。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, under pressure 550m out, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。五百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, good headway 400m out to 200m out, short of room final 200m, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。四百米處至二百米處追前甚多，最後二百米空位不足，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 3 wide behind midfield, difficult to settle in the early stages, 3 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。早段難以穩定走勢。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Awkward start, settled in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。以佳勢上前，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Inconvenienced at start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受妨礙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Ridden forward early from wide draw but unable to hold position, soon in rear, wide into home straight, stayed on, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘，早段在催策下上前，但未能保持位置，瞬即墮居後列。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Impeded shortly after start, settled in mid-field, checked when short of room 350m out, switched inside against rail for clear run 250m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久受阻，居中間位置。三百五十米處在空位不足下勒避。二百五十米處移入內欄以望空。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in front of midfield, gave ground quickly near 300M (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置。接近三百米處時迅速墮退（見競賽事件報告）。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure to hold position 800m out, ran on well in home straight but always held by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。八百米處在催策下保持位置。直路上以佳勢上前，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, minor progress made, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。略為上前。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Crowded start, unable to slot in, trapped wide in midfield on the outside, slightly taken back approaching 700M, found cover near 650M, 6-1/2L back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 起步時受擠迫，未能切入，居中間位置，走外疊。趨近七百米處時稍為留後。接近六百五十米處時取得遮擋。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 250m out, ran on well to close on winner late on but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至二百五十米處。末段以佳勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Mid-division, short of room when looking to improve from 400m out, stayed on once clear, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起在嘗試推進之際空位不足。望空後保持走勢，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, stayed close enough behind leaders, driven to 2nd near 300M, tried hard but couldn't quite wrestle the lead from leader, run ended 100M and lost 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，保持緊隨領先馬匹。接近三百米處時在催策下進佔第二位。力拼，但未能真正爭奪領先。一百米處無以為繼，失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, ran on strongly to lead close home and hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。其後以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid division, under pressure 600m out, switched wide for clear run 400m out, short-lived effort 200m out, unable to sustain.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。四百米處移出外疊以望空。二百米處一度發力，其後無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Began awkwardly and made contact, sent forward to take the early lead, headed 1100M, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，早段受催策上前，取得領先。千一米處被超越。中段落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, unable to pick up for pressure from 500m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策以跟隨領先馬匹。自五百米處起受催策，未能加速。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W5W) Widest throughout without cover, struggled to hold position on bend, lost touch final 200m, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W5W) 沿途走最外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米被拋離，洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, closed off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Held up in rear, pushed along over 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 留居後列。四百米處受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W) Settled handy, traveled wide, weakened passing 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。跑過二百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled fairly, disappointed for clear running, not fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置。走勢普通。未能望空，因而未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Well there, forced to check on rail turning into back straight, chased leaders in 4th to home turn, fought on steadily without troubling the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居好位。轉入對面直路時被迫勒避，走內欄。直路彎前居第四位，追趕領先馬匹。持續力拼，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, sat rear, limited response when asked, could not be ridden out when racing tight over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。對催策反應平平。末段緊迫競跑時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen early, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。直路初受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, challenged up rail from 350m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內欄。自三百五十米處起沿欄展開挑戰。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, followed winner into home straight, lacked pace to hold position from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時跟隨頭馬上前。自直路初起未能增速以保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) In rear after bumped out of stalls, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，其後居後列。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Made contact at start, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, very wide into straight, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路早段追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W2W1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced towards rear on the inside early, moved a bit closer along the rail in the middle stages, 4 lengths back turning in, angled out early in straight, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W2W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰。早段居後列，走內疊。中段沿欄略為追近。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W3W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W3W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W2W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍，對頭兩名馬匹未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 550M, a bit closer on turn, kept on well in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。自五百五十米處起走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W2W2W) Raced wide, improved to press leader 1100m out, unable to hold position 400m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W2W2W) 走外疊。千一米處推進以追迫領放馬。四百米處未能保持位置。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W5W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W3W3W) Blundered shortly after start, tracked leaders on the outside, challenged the leader turning in, took the lead early in straight, peaked and headed 75M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 起步後不久失蹄，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。直路初取得領先。七十五米處未能再增速及被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, well placed into home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時居好位。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 600m out, dropped away in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起難以保持位置。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped well, taken back to race 2 wide towards rear, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘迅速，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Bounded as stalls opened, rail position in rear of mid-field, headway halfway out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 開閘時向上跳躍，居中間之後位置，走內欄。半程時上前。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 900M, 2 lengths or so back on turn, angled out 500M, peaked early in straight, weakened final 200M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。接近九百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎落後約兩個馬位。五百米處向外移出。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置。在催策下反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Sat last from a wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, keen middle stages and switched wide, under pressure 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。中段搶口及移出外疊。五百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W1W) Made contact at start, positioned 3-1/2L behind the leader on rail, saved ground throughout, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，落後領放馬三個半馬位，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced better than midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back turning in, finished off well to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Jumped awkwardly and unbalanced, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 3-1/2L back, same margin back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 出閘笨拙及失去平衡，居中間稍後位置，落後三個半馬位，走外疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide in midfield early, 2 wide behind midfield from 900M, angled out 600M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自九百米處起居中間之後位置，走第二疊。六百米處向外移出。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Began well, raced 3 wide behind midfield early, 2 wide from 700M, angled out 400M, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間之後位置，走第三疊。自七百米處起走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Held up 3-wide with cover in midfield, in similar position into home straight, one-paced without quickening in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 留居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時居相若位置。末段保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Chased the lead, traveled nicely, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬，走勢良佳。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W) Pressed leaders on outside, one of three that raced clear to halfway, reined back into third, starting to come under pressure when severely checked 350m out, soon lost ground and eased.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 追迫領先馬匹，走外疊。為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。收慢留居第三位，其後在催策下開始發力上前，三百五十米處大力勒避。瞬即失地及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, kept on well for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Led or disputed lead throughout, pressed on turning into home straight, headed 100m out, no extra closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 沿途領先或爭奪領先。轉入直路時受催策。一百米處被超越。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Pressed leader, under pressure to hold position 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。五百米處在催策下保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 2 wide, 2 lengths or so back, there to turn, showed good response early in straight, peaked 250M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應良佳。二百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W2W1W) Slowly away, held up in last pair, under pressure when short of room 150m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W2W1W) 出閘緩慢，留居最後兩位之內。一百五十米處在受催策之際空位不足。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled towards rear on rail, commenced move rounding home bend, switched in for a clear run just inside the 200M, kept on steadily without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。轉直路彎時開始上前。跑過二百米處後向內移入以望空。末段保持穩勢，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, good headway middle stages, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。中段追前甚多。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced 2 wide at rear, 5-1/2L back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Raced in mid-division, not suited by slow early pace, swung wide for home but failed to make progress. (Jockey : raced too keenly and as a consequence unable to run on strongly in home straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，早段賽事步速慢，不合發揮。入直路時移出外疊。末段未能追前。（騎師表示，坐騎過於搶口，因而在直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Settled in last few and waited with, commenced move inside the 400M swinging wide into straight, ran on well to snatch victory near the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 居最後數位之內，留力待上。四百米處開始上前，入直路時移出外疊。以佳勢上前，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Held up in last pair, outpaced early in home straight, late gains but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 留居最後兩位之內。直路初被拋離。末段追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W2W) Commenced well, positioned 3-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 650M, same margin back turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬三個半馬位，走內疊。自六百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上移出外疊，末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Sat towards the rear, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居後列。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, driven top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄居中間之後位置。直路初受催策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Dropped back from draw 1 to race in midfield, had over 4Ls to make up 400M but couldn't muster the speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘後墮居中間位置。四百米處落後逾四個馬位。末段未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, angled out 450M, 8 to 9 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後八至九個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W4W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, switched wide but short of room final bend when trying to improve, clear run 300m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W4W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎在嘗試推進之際移出外疊，但空位不足。三百米處望空。保持走勢，但未能增速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, saved ground, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。末段走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Waited with towards rear, commenced move out wide 950m out, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。九百五十米處移出外疊開始發力。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Settled behind midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之後位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Waited with in rear, dropped to last place 750m out and soon ridden, passed a few tiring rivals in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。七百五十米處墮居包尾位置，瞬即受催策。直路上超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled well behind from the widest barrier, came under pressure to challenge just inside the 400m saving ground on rail turning in for home, ran on under pressure despite interrupted runs in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後遙居於後。跑過四百米處後在催策下展開挑戰。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。直路上儘管受阻礙，但在催策下上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped with them, positioned 2 wide, 5 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, finished off well to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。衝刺良佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced 3 wide with no cover, 2 lengths or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生觸碰，落後約兩個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W3W) Moderately away, positioned 2 wide in midfield, commenced move 750M, raced 3 wide, a length or so back on turn, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。七百五十米處開始上前，走第三疊。直路彎落後約一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W3W4W) In touch with leaders, wide into home straight, strong run to challenge leader 100m out, got on top final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走外疊。走勢強勁，一百米處向領放馬展開挑戰。最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, showed dash top of the Straight, one pace final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初加速上前。最後一百五十米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W4W) Towards rear, niggled along a fair way out, gradual headway from 400m out, stayed on into second final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W4W) 居後列，落後頗遠，受催策。自四百米處起逐漸上前。最後五十米保持走勢，跑入亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Began only fairly from gate 12, raced 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, angled off rail from 500m out for clear run, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自五百米處起移離內欄以望空。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W2W) Held up in last pair, laboured response to pressure home straight, no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W2W) 留居最後兩位之內。直路上在催策下跑來吃力，未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W1W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear, 6 lengths or so back on turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列。直路彎落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W1W1W) Sat last, held up rounding the Home Turn, closed off nicely between horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W1W1W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時受困。末段在馬匹之間衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Settled towards the rear, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Slow into stride and sat midfield the fence, saved ground throughout and travelled to the line okay when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。末段在催策下走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, 9 lengths or so back turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約九個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, sat worse than midfield, traveled okay, made steady progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走勢不俗。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W4W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield, moved up 600M to be tracking the pace turning into straight, kept on steadily to go 2nd mid-straight, no match for the runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處上前，轉入直路時跟隨領放馬。保持穩勢，直路中段進佔第二位，但不敵遙遙領先的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W3W) Bumped shortly after start, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, angled out approaching 450M, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，走內疊。趨近四百五十米處時向外移出。直路上對催策反應甚佳，二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, effort entering home straight, unable to challenge winner but stuck to task for clear second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時發力。未能挑戰頭馬，但持續力拼，帶離餘駒跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W4W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, improved after passing 800M, challenged the leader turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W4W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過八百米處後推進。入直路時挑戰領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，獲得亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W5W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W2W5W) Began only fairly, raced 3 wide behind midfield, 2 wide after entering the back straight, commenced move 600M, 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W2W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。進入對面直路後走第二疊。六百米處開始上前。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Fast into stride from draw 1 to take the lead, pressed by rival early and middle stages, struggled to keep up passing 300M, faded towards the finish. (Jockey - unsuited by being pressured in the lead.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，取得領先。早段及中段被對手追迫。跑過三百米處時掙扎上前。接近終點時轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在領放下被追迫不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled handy, traveled fairly, slightly weakened over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。走勢一般，末段略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W) Sent to forward to lead, kept on nicely without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W) 受催策上前，取得領先。保持佳勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W3W) Tracked pace, pushed along turning into home straight, weakened gradually.
(Sustained an abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。轉入直路時受推策。末段逐漸轉弱。
（左前腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat handy, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列。走勢不俗。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Waited with towards rear, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, ran on strongly to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 居後列，留力候上。未能望空直至三百米處。以勁勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Mid-field, wide throughout, stayed on final 200m, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置。沿途走外疊。最後二百米保持走勢，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 400m out, ran on well final 200m, closed on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米保持佳勢。末段追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, in rear, forced to steady on heels 500m out, made up some late ground.
(Respiratory condition.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑及與對手互相碰撞，居後列。五百米處被迫收慢避開對手的後蹄。末段略為追前。
（異常呼吸狀況。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Waited with in rear, switched wide 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 居後列，留力候上。三百米處移出外疊，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Slightly slow out and bumped, raced towards rear on the inside, 8 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢及與對手互相碰撞，居後列，落後約八個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, lay in in the Straight, limited response. (See Incident Report)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上內閃。末段對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Mid-field, ridden along into home straight and unable to hold position, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。入直路時受催策，未能保持位置。轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Settled wide in last few dropping to last about 900M out, made no further impression from a similar position into home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 居最後數位之內，走外疊。約九百米處墮居包尾位置。入直路時居相若位置，其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Soon taken back to worse than midfield, lost cover 3-wide rounding home bend dropping to last into straight, kept on under pressure past well-beaten horses.
(Sustained a cut to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a cut to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 瞬即留居中間之後位置。轉直路彎時走第三疊，失去遮擋。入直路時墮居包尾位置。在催策下保持走勢，末段超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。
（右前腿割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well from gate 12, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W3W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W3W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Keen and pressed leader, one of three that raced clear to halfway, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 搶口，追迫領放馬。為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。走勢暢順。以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat on pace, ran on fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居前列。走勢一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) From gate 10 slid forward to be one off tracking the leader, failed to sustain run and swamped in the last 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。無以為繼，最後一百五十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W) Shared early lead, settled one back in 3rd on rail rounding home bend, baulked for a run early in straight, found no extra when checked 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W) 早段並排領先。轉直路彎時居第三位，落後一個馬位，走內欄。直路早段受困。一百五十米處勒避時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 600m out, one paced under pressure, impeded 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起難以保持位置。在催策下保持同速。一百米處受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, shared lead turning in, peaked 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時並排領先。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier, obtained rails run in front 1000M out setting a steady pace, kicked some 2L clear on straightening but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M and collared close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入內欄，一千米處取得領先，以平穩步速領放。入直路時加速帶離約兩個馬位，但最後一百米後勁不繼，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leader, under pressure to chase leader 450m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬。四百五十米處在催策下追趕領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, followed winner through 300m out, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百米處跟隨頭馬上前，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly, sat a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began smartly from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前帶頭。入直路時領先四分三馬位。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Mid-field, once paced under pressure, late gains but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。末段追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out after passing 400M, 4 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the finish
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W5W) Sat midfield 3 wide, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W3W) Settled behind midfield, traveled smoothly, made steady progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置。走勢暢順。穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Settled worse than midfield, traveled okay, responded reasonably well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置。走勢尚可。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, had every chance in the Straight, unable to go pass the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，但未能超越頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced wide without cover, chased along early, driven along 450m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段追趕領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持佳勢，但最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually close home, just stayed on to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱，僅能保持走勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began smartly from gate 11, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to lead, quickened early in home straight and kicked two lengths away 100m out, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘後受催策，取得領先。直路早段加速，一百米處帶離兩個馬位。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, ran on evenly, lost 2nd on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢，一百五十米處未能再增速及被超越。末段保持穩勢，過終點時失去亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W1W1W) Away with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, no clear run early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路早段未能望空，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W2W3W) Drawn wide, held up last, pushed along from top of home straight, stayed on down the outside, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。自直路初起受推策。在外疊保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in last few, made up good ground in home straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居最後數位之內。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Prominent and wide early after beginning from the widest draw, gradually drifted over 3L back 3-wide 1000M out, gained 6th briefly in a similar position on top of home bend, faded into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 自大外檔出閘，早段居前列，走外疊。一千米處逐漸墮退，落後逾三個馬位，走第三疊。直路初居相若位置，一度進佔第六位。入直路時力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly losing ground settling in midfield on rail after moderate start, came under pressure into home straight, ran on steadily but unable to peg back the winner throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘普通，笨拙及失地，其後居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時受催策，沿途以穩勢上前，但未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Jumped awkwardly from wide stall, quickly recovered to track leaders in wide position, ridden to challenge 200m out and every chance, winner too strong final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘笨拙，迅速恢復走勢，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。二百米處受催策展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後一百米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, peaked and headed 400M, weakened thereafter.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。四百米處未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat handy, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走勢尚可。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Ridden along and outpaced early stages, wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。入直路時走外疊。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, driven along bend, unable to quicken, stayed on final 100m, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。直路彎受催策，未能加速。最後一百米保持走勢，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Sat towards rear, traveled fairly well, made steady ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居後列，走勢不俗。直路上以穩勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, sat behind midfield, lay out at the Straight, proved difficult to ride out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置。直路上外閃。難以被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W5W) Broke well, gradually settled 3-wide in forward of midfield, gained slightly closer to 3L 6th rounding home bend before swinging 5-wide into straight, soon weakened under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W5W) 出閘迅速，逐漸居中間之前位置，走第三疊。轉直路彎時略為追近，居第六位，落後三個馬位。入直路時移出第五疊。在催策下瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, keen early, under pressure to challenge leader 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬，早段搶口。五百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Sat on pace, raced wide, failed to respond when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W4W) Sat at the rear 3 wide, closed off okay from the rear. (Barrier manners unacceptable, must BT)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。末段自後列衝刺尚可。（閘廂行為難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Recovered from slow start to race in mid-field, race keenly throughout, driven 400m out, no extra final 200m.
(Blood in trachea and roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘緩慢，恢復走勢後居中間位置。沿途搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米再無餘力。
（氣管有血及再次患有喘鳴症。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （氣管有血及再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Stood flat-footed at start and lost ground, caught up to main body of runners after 700m, widest into home straight, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 開閘時四蹄滯立，因而失地。過了七百米處後追上主馬群。入直路時走最外疊。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) In rear after slow start, keen after checked early on, had to wait for a run between 400m out and 250m out, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。早段勒避後搶口。四百米處至二百五十米處之間須等待空位出現。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, driven along 600m out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受催策。末段以佳勢上前，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, held up last, ridden along and outpaced middle stages, left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，留居包尾位置。中段受催策，但未能跟上步速。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide behind midfield, found rail approaching 700M, saved ground on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。趨近七百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, struggled to hold position and taken widest on bend, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置，移出最外疊。遙遙落後時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Out with rest, positioned 2 wide better than midfield, angled out approaching 650M, 3 wide turning in, showed good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on well to hold off the challengers late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。趨近六百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時走第三疊。直路上對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處帶頭。末段保持佳勢，力拒對手挑戰勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W5W) Slowly into stride and shuffled back, detached and pushed along widest 500m out, late headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W5W) 展步緩慢，墮後。被拋離，五百米處受推策，走最外疊。末段追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Settled midfield, lay in in the Home Straight, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置。直路上內閃，走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, tracked leaders, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久與他駒互相觸碰，跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Showed good speed to across, headed 250m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，切入內疊。二百五十米處被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, peaked on run near 400M, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。接近四百米處時未能再增速。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 400m out, headed by rivals 100m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。四百米處加速。一百米處被對手超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Prominent, outpaced and dropped to rear halfway, clear run 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 居前列。未能跟上步速，半程時墮居後列。二百米處望空。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W1W) Sat off pace, limited response in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W1W) 居領放馬之後。直路上對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, not enough room early in straight, showed limited response thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段空位不足，其後對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat worse than midfield, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, driven 500m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, took the early lead, headed 1250M, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader in the middle stages, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，早段取得領先。一千二百五十米處被超越。中段落後領放馬一個半馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Sat worse than midfield 2 wide, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Dropped in from wide draw after sluggish start, raced in last pair, stayed on into mid-division, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 自外檔出閘緩慢，移入內疊，居最後兩位之內。保持走勢，進佔中間位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and bumped, raced better than midfield on the outside, finished off strongly, just beaten in a ding-dong battle.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居中間之前位置，走外疊。末段衝刺強勁，叮噹馬頭下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Shifted out and bumped at start, mid division, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑及發生碰撞。居中間位置。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。走勢良佳，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began smartly from the widest draw, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Average to begin, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, took the lead 400M, peaked and headed approaching 100M, stayed on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。四百米處取得領先。趨近一百米處時未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, driven 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, chased along final bend, challenged up rail final 200m, lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎追趕對手。最後二百米沿欄展開挑戰，但未能增速以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, hung out in the Home Straight, failed to run out (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路上外閃，未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, bumped near 600M, 2-1/2L back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時發生碰撞。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out and made contact near 450M, no clear run until approaching final 100M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。接近四百五十米處時向外移出及發生觸碰。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat on pace, weakened slightly passing the 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列。跑過二百五十米處時略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield early, dropped to midfield near 800M, 5 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近八百米處時墮居中間位置。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Raced prominently, keen, lost place turning into home straight, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，搶口。轉入直路時失位，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, travelled keenly, weakened from the 300M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速及領放，跑來搶口。自三百米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W4W5W) Waited with towards rear, headway widest final bend, strong run to lead over 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W4W5W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎上前，走最外疊。衝刺強勁，一百米處取得領先。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W5W) Raced very widest without cover throughout, some headway on bend, lost touch final 300m, left behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W5W) 沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。最後三百米未能跟上對手，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled behind midfield 6Ls back, only battled home final 400M and was safely held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，落後六個馬位。最後四百米僅能勉力而為，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W) Raced wide in rear, improved to track pace out wide without cover 900m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W) 居後列，走外疊。推進以跟隨領放馬，九百米處走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced 2 wide at rear, angled out 500M, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Raced prominently, challenged 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居前列。二百米處展開挑戰。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路早段未能再增速及被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Led on the rail, traveled smoothly, shifted out under pressure, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 沿欄領放，走勢暢順。在催策下向外斜跑，已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield, lay in in the Home Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置。直路上內閃。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat behind the lead, traveled strongly, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬之後，走勢強勁。保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, hard ridden from 400M, struck the running rail 300m becoming unbalanced, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 75M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前，取得領先。直路彎前走勢良佳。自四百米處起受力策。三百米處踢中內欄，失去平衡。保持佳勢，但最後七十五米未能抗衡頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, took the lead approaching 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎位置相同。趨近二百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢，但終點線上未能抗衡頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W1W1W) Mid division, ridden top of home straight, challenged up rail from 200m out, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W1W1W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。自二百米處起沿內欄展開挑戰，以佳勢追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W2W2W) Raced wide, tracked pace, forward move halfway to race outside of leader, unable to stay with that rival, one paced under pressure home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W2W2W) 走外疊，跟隨領放馬。半程時上前居領放馬外側競跑，其後未能跟上該駒。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on in a close finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。在多駒幾乎齊過終點下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled handy, traveled nicely, pressed on rounding the Turn, responded well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢良佳。轉直路彎時受催策。末段對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, ridden to hold position 600m out, shifted out final bend, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處在催策下保持位置。直路彎向外斜跑。其後未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Crowded at start, settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, was severely checked in the middle stages, made some steady ground final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後。中段大力勒避。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Sat last on the rail, held up early part of the Straight, ran on nicely once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居包尾位置，走內欄。直路早段受困，望空後以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Sat towards rear, improved from 400M, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。自四百米處起推進。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Niggled along in rear of midfield in 7th on rail, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, baulked for a run from inside the 200M and could make no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策，居中間之後第七位，走內欄。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處起受困。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W5W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, swung wide in the straight, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路上移出外疊，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W6W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide towards rear, 3 wide approaching 700M, 5 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W6W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。趨近七百米處時走第三疊。直路彎落後五個馬位。入直路時走大外疊，末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) From draw 3 settled down in midfield along the inside, couldn't go on turning into straight, weakened rapidly to finish tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。轉入直路時無以為繼。其後迅速轉弱，包尾大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Gradually settled at the back from a wide barrier, detached from over 500M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸留居後列。自五百米處起被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W1W) Settled in mid-field, keen early stages, ridden to hold position 900m out, outpaced and left behind in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間位置。早段搶口。九百米處受催策以保持位置。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Reserved in mid-division 5Ls off the pace before keeping on steadily over final 300M to take 4th. (Jockey fined for returning to scale 2 lbs overweight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 留居中間位置，落後領放馬五個馬位。最後三百米保持穩勢，取得第四名。（騎師因返回覆磅時超磅兩磅而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W1W) Gradually settled in midfield, drifted further back when tempo increased 800M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W1W) 逐漸居中間位置。八百米處步速加快時進一步墮退。從未能收復失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W3W) Chased leaders in a steadily run race, close enough top of the straight, kept battling to the line and got up for 3rd close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，賽事步速平穩。直路初保持落後領先馬匹不遠。末段持續力拼，接近終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 2 wide at rear, wider on turn, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自第十檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。直路彎走更外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Clean jump, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘俐落，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。三百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear, wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。入直路時走外疊。末段速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled smoothly on the rail, pressed on near the 600M, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄，走勢暢順。接近六百米處時受催策。末段衝剌強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, under pressure 500m out, followed winner through in home straight, ran on well final 200m to close on winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。五百米處受催策。直路上跟隨頭馬上前。最後二百米以佳勢衝刺，追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat against the fence midfield, briefly blocked for a run, stayed on ok, something further would suit.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。一度受困而未能望空。末段保持尚可走勢。增程角逐或更合發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Sat midfield, traveled okay, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走勢尚可。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W2W3W) Mid-field, forced wide and tight for room turning into home straight, again short of room 200m out, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時被迫走外疊，受緊迫。二百米處再度空位不足。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, held up between 300M and 200M, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處至二百米處之間受困。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W4W) Tracked pace, wide into home straight, stayed on, not beaten far but unable to reach leader.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W4W) 跟隨領放馬。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，所負不遠，但未能追及領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W1W1W1W) Tracked leading pair, angled off rail over 300m out, stayed on, lacked pace to trouble winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。三百米處移離內欄。保持走勢，但速度不足以威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W5W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Towards rear, struggling and left well behind from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列。自直路初起掙扎上前，落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W2W4W) Held up last, driven along and outpaced middle stages, wide into home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W2W4W) 留居包尾位置。中段受催策及被拋離。入直路時走外疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, left behind home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎難以保持位置。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, minor progress made when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。末段在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Keen in mid-field, rail position, unable to quicken 300m out, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 中段搶口，走內欄。三百米處未能加速，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W1W1W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, held up, keen under restraint, forward move 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W1W1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞。受困，在約束下搶口。三百米處上前，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield the fence, failed to respond given a few reminders over final stages, eased down last 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段數度受鞭策，毫無反應，最後一百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, gave ground passing the 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 居前列，走勢一般。跑過一百五十米處時墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders, tried to challenge up rail from 450m up, unable to pick up for pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自四百五十米處起嘗試展開挑戰，走內欄。直路上受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, steadied near 200M, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段對催策反應平平，接近二百米處時收慢，其後再度收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, headed 300m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，切入領放。三百米處被超越。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in midfield, made steady headway under pressure after straightening, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路後在催策下穩步上前。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Sat towards rear, angled out at the Turn, ran on evenly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。以穩勢上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Sat last, held up rounding the Home Turn, picked off a few weakened rivals. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居包尾位置。轉直路彎時受困。超越部分已轉弱的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W4W) Jumped well from gate 13, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 450M, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W4W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。四百五十米處向外移出。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, pushed along into home straight, switched inside over 200m out, tight for room final 100m, unable to be ridden out fully.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時受推策。二百米處移入內疊。最後一百米受緊迫，未能被全力催策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began well from the widest draw and amongst leaders 3-wide, gained 2-wide position alongside leader over 900M out, held every chance and hit the front momentarily over 100M out, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，居領先馬群中，走第三疊。九百米處與領放馬並跑，走第二疊。極具爭勝機會，一百米處一度領先，但瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W2W) Tracked leaders, driven along to chase leaders 550m out, flattened out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W3W) Mid-division, hung out on bends, lost position 600m out, soon well held, eased.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎外閃。六百米處失位。瞬即被拋離，收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced better than midfield on the outside early, raced in 2nd after entering the back straight, 1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，早段居中間之前位置，走外疊。進入對面直路後居第二位。轉入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初未能再加速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Waited with towards rear, not best of runs 400m out to 150m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處至一百五十米處之間未能完全望空。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Tracked leaders, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, taken wider into home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。入直路時移出較外疊，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced 3 wide, a length or so back, moved a bit closer after passing 1200M, 2 wide from 1000M, 1/2L back turning in, peaked 300M, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第三疊。跑過千二米處後略為追近。自一千米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。三百米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Broke well from a poor draw sharing early pace, gradually settled some 1L back in 2nd from 1050M out, renewed effort into straight holding every chance until finding no extra inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，早段並排領先。自一千零五十米處起逐漸居第二位，落後約一個馬位。入直路時重新發力。一度甚具爭勝機會，直至最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W5W) Mid division, switched wide with cover 800m out, pushed along wide into home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W5W) 居中間位置。八百米處移出外疊，有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走外疊。衝刺強勁，一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢，保住勝局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Stayed close to leaders but raced wide without cover for the majority of the race, hard driven from 450M, responded well to be challenging for the lead final stages, held by first two at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹，但大部分途程走外疊，沒有遮擋。自四百五十米處起受力策，反應良佳。末段爭奪領先，過終點時落後首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Away well, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, made contact near 400M, no clear early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, kept on well until final 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。接近四百米處時與對手互相觸碰。直路初未能望空。趨近二百米處時望空。保持佳勢直至五十米處。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W4W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, chased leaders 450m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處追趕領先馬匹。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly and bumped, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相碰撞。居中間之前位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。
