runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled further back in the field than intended, pressed along 450M but failed to run on in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居較部署為後的位置。四百五十米處受催策，但直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W2W) Clean jump, raced in 2nd, a length back, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked on run 100M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W2W) 出閘俐落，居第二位，落後一個馬位。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Lowered its head as stalls opened and lost ground, in rear, severely checked 1400m out, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 開閘時將頭低俯，失地，居後列。千四米處大力勒避。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W3W) Reserved behind midfield, pace very slow first half of the race, switched away from fence 400M, ran on steadily to the line without threatening first three.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W3W) 留居中間之後位置，賽事前半段步速非常緩慢。自四百米處起移離內欄。末段以穩勢上前，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield, gained 6th into back straight about 4L back, swung one of the widest into straight, responded well inside final 200M to hit the front 100M out and soon kicked clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。入對面直路時進佔第六位，落後約四個馬位。入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。最後二百米對催策反應良佳。一百米處取得領先，瞬即帶離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W5W) Held up near last in a strongly run race, pushed along 550M, brought wide for his challenge but failed to come on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 留居接近包尾位置，賽事步速甚快。五百五十米處受推策。移出外疊展開挑戰，但未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, chased along final bend, tight of room 400m out to 200m out and lost balance 250m out, weaved through field to lead final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎追趕對手。四百米處至二百米處之間受緊迫。二百五十米處失去平衡。穿過馬群上前，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W4W) Settled wide with cover in last few, one of the widest turning for home at the back, went past a few well-beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W4W) 居最後數位之內，走外疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時居後列，走最外疊。末段超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Bumped at the start, settled ahead of midfield about 3Ls off the pace, moved up to 3rd early straight, fought hard but couldn't close off as well as the leaders final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。直路早段追前至第三位。末段力拼，但最後二百米的衝刺不及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Tracked leaders against rail, travelled smoothly to 400m out, shifted left early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百米處前走勢暢順。直路初向外斜跑。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leaders, quickened 400m out to lead 250m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處加速，二百五十米處取得領先。走勢良佳，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Away well, chased leader in a strongly run race, drove hard passing 300M and edged ahead last stride. Won in class record time.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，追趕領放馬，賽事步速甚快。跑過三百米處時受力策。最後一步取得領先。以破班次紀錄時間勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W5W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。衝刺凌厲，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, angled out rounding the Home Turn, ran on strongly, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時向外移出。以強勢上前，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 7 lengths or so back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, short of room early in home straight, badly held up for clear running final 150m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初空位不足。最後一百五十米嚴重受困而未能望空，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W1W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to vie for lead obtaining rails run in front just inside the 1200M, held over 1L advantage into straight but unable to sustain effort and caught 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前，爭奪領先。跑過千二米處後在領放下移入內欄。入直路時領先逾一個馬位，但其後無以為繼，五十米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, easy run to turn, angled out early in straight, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路初向外移出。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，僅以一馬頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, ran on well but headed close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初加速。二百米處取得領先。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, challenged and every chance from 400m out, stayed on but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢，但不敵頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W7W) Jumped with them, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, no cover from 800M, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W7W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。自八百米處起沒有遮擋。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, easy run to turn, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, cleared 150M, kept on well to take a place, not quite able to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎前走勢輕鬆。直路早段未能望空。一百五十米處望空，保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，未能展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W6W) Sluggish start, dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but no further impression close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W6W) 自大外檔起步緩慢，墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但接近終點時再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Gradually settled towards rear racing 3-wide with cover down back straight, swung one of the widest turning in for home, ran on dourly under pressure to claim victory close to post.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 對面直路上逐漸居後列，走第三疊，有遮擋。轉入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。在催策下持續力拼，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Settled down in midfield along the 2-path, driven wide into straight, couldn't sustain run passing 250M and weakened. (Jockey - horse lay out in the home straight. / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時受催策，走外疊。跑過二百五十米處時無以為繼，轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在直路上外閃。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Soon taken across from a poor draw for rails run in midfield in 7th some 4L off the pace, gained slightly closer to 6th in back straight, saved ground turning in for home, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即切入內欄取位，居中間第七位，落後領放馬約四個馬位。對面直路上略為追近至第六位。轉入直路時走內欄節省腳程。以穩勢上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 200m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。二百米處向外移出取位。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Made running, headed by winner 350m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 領放。三百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, hung out on bend, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, faded final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎外閃。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made all, kicked 400m out, stayed on well in home straight and soon in command, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 一放到底。四百米處加速。直路上保持佳勢，瞬即控制大局。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Box seat, well placed into home straight, bumped and lost balance 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。入直路時居好位。三百米處被碰撞，失去平衡。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W2W2W) Allowed to stride on and take narrow lead before halfway, headed 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W2W2W) 獲許展步上前，半程前領先短距離。二百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W1W) Wide early, sent forward and led after 500m, headed over 200m out, soon weakened.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 早段走外疊。受催策上前，跑了五百米後領放。二百米處被超越，瞬即轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, could not be quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W) Across to press leader, ridden 600m out to chase leader, briefly bumped 250m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 切入追迫領放馬。六百米處受催策以追趕領放馬。二百五十米處一度被碰撞。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。未能望空直至二百米處。末段未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W4W) Waited with in rear, commenced move out wide without cover 900m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處開始上前，走外疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, commenced move approaching 400M, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。趨近四百米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Waited with in rear, some headway out wide middle stages, sustained headway in home straight but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。中段略為追前，走外疊。直路上持續上前，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W4W) Settled just behind midfield, moved closer over the home turn to be 3Ls off leader 400M, fought hard in the straight couldn't find the extra gear to challenge first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W4W) 居中間稍後位置。直路彎追近。四百米處落後領放馬三個馬位。直路上力拼，但未能加速以挑戰頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Led entering first turn setting slow pace, overtaken 750M, went for the lead again turning in, drew level with eventual winner mid-straight before going down by narrow margin in a nail biting finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 進入首個彎位時以慢步速領放。七百五十米處被超越。入直路時再度上前爭奪領先。直路中段追上頭馬，末段在力拼下僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders against rail, angled out to make run top of home straight, stayed on but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初向外移出取位。保持走勢，但末段未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, keen under restraint, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。在約束下搶口。直路初受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越，末段持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。走勢良佳，二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Followed leader to get across, chased leader, ridden top of home straight, faded final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬以切入，追趕領放馬。直路初受催策。最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, made some progress early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well from the 2 draw, gained outright lead passing the winning post the first time and rails run shortly after, travelled keenly from the 1100M in back straight, maintained narrow advantage around home bend, swamped.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘迅速，首次跑過終點時單騎領放，其後不久走內欄。自對面直路千一米處起搶口。轉直路彎時以短距離領先，其後被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, eased close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。直路早段加速，瞬即控制大局。接近終點時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, ridden along to lead, traveled nicely, kept on well to hold 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，在催策下取得領先，走勢良佳。直路上保持佳勢，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, short of room 400m out to 200m out, switched for clear run 200m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處至二百米處之間空位不足。二百米處轉換跑線以望空，速度不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Away well, raced better than midfield but trapped wide, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took effect.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 300M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路初未能望空。跑過三百米處後望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the inside, angled out 500M, 6-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Held up in mid-division, drifted back a bit on the home turn, had difficulty obtaining clear running from 400M -200M before staying on steadily to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 留居中間位置。直路彎略為墮後。四百米處至二百米處之間難以望空。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) From draw 1 stayed close enough to leaders in early and middle stages, got tired passing 300M and was easily accounted for.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，早段及中段保持緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百米處時呈現疲態，其後被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to pick up for pressure from top of home straight, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初在催策下未能加速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 2 stayed close enough to early pace before settling back in midfield along the inside, held up for clear running making the home turn, crowded for room near 200M and not able to be ridden out to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，早段居接近領放馬的位置，其後留居中間位置，走內疊。轉直路彎時受困而未能望空。接近二百米處時受擠迫，未能被全力催策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped awkward but soon in first few settling over 2L back in 4th 2-wide, came under pressure from 500M out swinging wide into straight, ran on steadily under pressure to hold every only to be outsprinted late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，但瞬即進佔前列第四位，落後逾兩個馬位，走第二疊。自五百米處起受催策，入直路時移出外疊。在催策下保持穩勢，已獲機會盡展所長，末段僅被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear, held up making the Home Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。轉直路彎時受困。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W3W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, made some progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W3W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路上略為追前，取得第四名，但未能對前列馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, raced in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W5W) Waited with towards rear, commenced move out wide 700m out, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W5W) 居後列，留力候上。七百米處開始上前，走外疊。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, challenged and every chance early in home straight, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。其後保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, there to turn, no clear run and made contact early in straight, cleared 300M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能望空，與對手互相觸碰。三百米處望空，其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly and settled near the rear, pushed wide after 600M before running home fairly in the straight. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。過了六百米處後受推策，走外疊。直路上衝刺一般。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 2 wide on turn, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎走第二疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2 lengths back, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，居中間之前位置，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段保持佳勢，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Towards rear in race run at fast pace, weaved through runners to chase leaders 150m out, led on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，賽事步速甚快。一百五十米處在馬匹之間穿插上前，追趕領先馬匹。過終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, kicked 400m out, strong challenge from runner-up in home straight, stayed on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。四百米處加速。直路上受亞軍馬匹的強勁挑戰。保持佳勢，保住勝局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced better than midfield on outer, moved closer after passing 1200M, 2nd in the middle stages, 2 wide, bumped 300M, peaked near 200M, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過千二米處後追近。中段居第二位，走第二疊。三百米處發生碰撞。接近二百米處時未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Held up after shifted out and forced to steady at start, switched for clear run 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，被迫收慢留後。五百米處轉換跑線以望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Never better than midfield, kept on same pace under pressure without quickening in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 從未超越中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier before gradually taken back to race in last few, fought on steadily from a similar position into straight but never threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，其後逐漸留居最後數位之內。入直路時居相若位置，持續力拼，但從未構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Chased leading group in the 6th spot, couldn't keep up after straightening, tired final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 追趕領先馬匹，居第六位。入直路後未能跟上。最後二百米呈現疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Broke well settling within 3L of the pace in 7th, tightened just inside the 600M and baulked briefly upon straightening, ran on steadily under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第七位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。跑過六百米處後受緊迫。入直路時一度受困。在催策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Sat near midfield 2 off the outside rail, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居接近中間位置，走外欄第三疊。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Jumped awkwardly, sat worse than midfield on the stands rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走外欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Niggled along behind midfield, in similar position into straight, kept on at the same pace without quickening under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 受催策上前，居中間之後位置。入直路時居相若位置。末段在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。保持走勢直至最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, pressed on entering home straight, closed down final 100m, headed late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭。進入直路時受催策。最後一百米被追近。末段被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced prominently, 2 wide, a length or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約一個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped nicely and led, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Out in line, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to lead, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。保持佳勢，跑入亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 2-3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。轉入直路時領先二又四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, ridden top of home straight, 1l clear 200m out, headed 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，切入帶頭。直路初受催策。二百米處帶離一個馬位。一百米處被超越。其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Never far off leaders in 4th place, moved up to 2nd early straight, run ended 200M and faded away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居第四位，從未遠離領先馬匹。直路初進佔第二位。二百米處無以為繼，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Led, weakened from the 150M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 領放。自一百五十米處起轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made running, headed 150m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;帶頭。一百五十米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Driven along from stalls to lead 700m out, kicked 300m out, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘後受催策。七百米處取得領先。三百米處加速。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, took the lead 950M, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。九百五十米處取得領先，入直路時領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, kept on to hold 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走勢尚可。保持走勢，保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Average to begin, raced better than midfield, nearer to the middle track, kept on well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘普通。居中間之前位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W) Bumped start, took the early lead, headed and made contact near 900M, 2nd on turn, hard ridden after passing 350M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，早段領放。接近九百米處時被超越及與對手互相觸碰。直路彎居第二位，跑過三百五十米處後受力策，但反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W9W) Prominent, badly hampered when taken wider by winner 550m out and lost ground, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W9W) 居前列。五百五十米處被頭馬帶出較外疊之際嚴重受阻礙，失地。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W3W) Slow to being, sat worse than midfield on the rail, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off well, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳，帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) In rear after slow start, steadied off heels on occasions, good headway up rail home straight, improving to chase leaders when running out of room closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，數度收慢避開他駒後蹄。直路上沿欄追前甚多。末段推進上前，追趕領先馬匹，但空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Prominent, keen early, pushed along 400m out to chase leaders, looked like winner 300m out but weakened final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，早段搶口。四百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。三百米處甚具勝望，但最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W2W) Prominent early stages, drifted some 3L off the pace about 900M out, in similar position in 5th rounding home bend swinging wide into straight, kept on at the one pace without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W2W) 早段居前列。約九百米處墮退，落後領放馬約三個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若的第五位。入直路時移出外疊。保持同速，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length at 400M, peaked and headed 250M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;起步時與對手互相碰撞，受催策上前領放。四百米處領先一個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Sluggish start, raced towards centre of course and rear of mid-field, good progress to lead 300m out but shifting out, unable to sustain final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，在接近跑道中央競跑。追前甚多，三百米處取得領先，但向外斜跑。最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, weakened final 150M.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。最後一百五十米轉弱。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Tracked leaders, driven along 450m out, hung out final 400m, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;跟隨領先馬匹。四百五十米處受催策。最後四百米外閃。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away well, took the early lead, headed 600M, 2nd on turn, peaked 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段領放。六百米處被超越。直路彎居第二位。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed speed to get across, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現前速以切入內疊。直路初受催策。三百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Sat handy, weakened final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;居前列。最後四百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in mid-field, struggled to hold position halfway, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置。半程時難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Away with them, raced 3 wide in midfield, lay out making the turns in the middle stages, peaked near 500M, 5 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊。中段轉彎時外閃。接近五百米處時未能再增速。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W) Settled in front midfield 2 wide, switched out in the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leading pair, stuck to task under pressure and never far away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。在催策下保持走勢。從未遠離領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race behind midfield on outer, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled on pace 2 wide, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 12, raced in midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，取得季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Towards rear, stayed on final 150m, lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但速度不足以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, made contact near 700M, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 150M, showed limited response thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。接近七百米處時發生觸碰。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空，一百五十米處望空，其後對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in mid-field, pushed along 400m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置。四百米處受推策，未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along 200m out, one paced and unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。二百米處受推策。保持同速，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 200m, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W5W) Jumped only fairly and sat towards the rear, overracing, made minor progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。搶口。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat towards the rear, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Jumped awkwardly, settled midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。趨近二百米處時未能再增速，被超越。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Began only fairly, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 away from the stands' rail, peaked 350M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘僅屬一般。落後領放馬一個馬位，走外欄第三疊。三百五十米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped with them, raced prominently on the stands' rail, hard ridden 300M but only showed limited response, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居前列，走外欄。三百米處受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, ridden along to press leader, struggled to hold position from 300m out, eased when jockey was concerned about its action.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞。受催策，追迫領放馬。自三百米處起難以保持位置。騎師對坐騎的動作有疑慮時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Soon picked up to midfield after moderate start, kept on same pace without quickening in home straight, looked beaten when steadied 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通後瞬即加速，居中間位置。直路上保持同速，未能加速。一百五十米處在收慢之際看似洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded after sluggish start, raced in rear, headway through field from over 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，其後受擠迫，居後列。自二百米處起在馬群中穿插上前。保持走勢。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Slightly slow out and bumped, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘稍慢，發生碰撞，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the stands' side, 3 lengths or so back, kept on same pace final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久受擠迫。居中間之後位置，落後約三個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, weakened at the top of the Straight, closed off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列。直路初轉弱。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide near midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W1W) Took up running just before the 1000M bend, obtained rails run over 800M out, led until headed after straightening, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W1W) 就在一千米處彎位前取得領先。八百米處移入內欄。保持領先，直至入直路後被超越，迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Pressed in front, unable to hold position by halfway and dropped away quickly, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;在領放下受追迫。半程前未能保持位置。其後迅速墮退。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, headed 200m out, weakened, eased final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。轉弱，最後五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後一百五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled mainly in midfield, commenced move on rail rounding home bend, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 大多居中間位置。轉直路彎時開始沿欄上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Gradually taken back from a wide barrier to be last with rails run 750M out, improved steadily closer home bend reaching 5L 10th into straight, ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，逐漸留後。七百五十米處居包尾位置，走內欄。直路彎穩步上前追近，入直路時進佔第十位，落後五個馬位。末段以佳勢上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Box seat, switched for clear run 400m out, quickened early in home straight to lead 250m out, tired closing stages and just held fourth.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 居包廂位置。四百米處轉換跑線以望空。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。末段呈現疲態，僅能保住第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (5W3W3W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, raced wide and without cover in the early stages, raced keenly near 800M, finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(5W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。早段走外疊，沒有遮擋。接近八百米處時搶口。衝刺強勁，跑獲第二名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W4W) Made contact shortly after start, positioned 2 wide, 4 lengths back in the early stages, 3 wide after passing 700M, slightly improved on turn, very wide into straight, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W4W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，走第二疊。早段落後四個馬位。跑過七百米處後走第三疊。直路彎略為追前。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders, pressed on 300m out, soon on top and won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策，瞬即取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Sat towards rear, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。走勢尚可。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Jumped with the field, settled slightly worse than midfield, improved around the field 450M out, stayed on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍後位置。四百五十米處繞過馬群上前。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, good headway final bend, sustained headway to challenge 200m out, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎追前甚多。持續上前，二百米處展開挑戰，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Away well, raced 2 wide in 2nd, 3/4L back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Soon taken back behind midfield in 9th from a wide barrier, did not find much room in home straight racing in a tight run inside final 100M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居中間之後第九位。直路上空位不足，最後一百米緊迫競跑。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Broke well but soon taken back to 5th just over 2L off the pace, shifted wider for a run entering straight but unable to quicken to challenge under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即留居第五位，落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。入直路時移出較外疊以取位，但在催策下未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield, lay in in the early Straight, gave ground inside 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初內閃。一百五十米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride towards the rear, brought wide into straight before running on moderately to the finish. Posed no threat to first three however.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，留力候上。入直路時移出外疊。保持不俗走勢至終點，但未能對頭三名馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Held up last after crowded leaving stalls, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受擠迫，其後留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for room turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with towards rear, forced to angle wide for clear run 150m out, quickened well final 100m to lead late on, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。一百五十米處被迫移出外疊以望空。最後一百米加速良佳，末段進佔領先位置，從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began smartly from a tricky draw, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden along 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。三百米處受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Began from the middle draw to make all, taking advantage of the slow early tempo to obtain rails run over 800M out, driven over 2L clear briefly inside the 150M, won cozily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 自中檔出閘，一放到底。利用賽事早段慢步速的優勢，八百米處佔取內欄位置。受催策，一百五十米處一度帶離逾兩個馬位。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Chased leader, every chance 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。三百米處一度甚具爭勝機會。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed by winner 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路初受催策。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Fast into stride, raced prominently on the stands' rail, hard ridden from 400M but only showed limited response, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘迅速，居前列，走外欄。自四百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, peaked 300M, headed 250M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。三百米處未能再增速。二百五十米處被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, settled midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along final bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped on terms and utilised his early pace to take up the front-running position, run ended at 200m, soon headed and weakened considerably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，利用前速領放。二百米處無以為繼，瞬即被超越，嚴重轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded at start, raced in touch with leaders, driven 400m out, short of room final 150m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。最後一百五十米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Held up in last pair, stayed on final 200m, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 留居最後兩位之內。最後二百米保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well to move into third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。以佳勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W3W) Prominent 4-wide before taken one-out-one-back for cover 700M out, came to challenge entering straight but had nothing to give.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W3W) 居前列，走第四疊。七百米處居第二疊第二位以取得遮擋。入直路時上前展開挑戰，但再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W3W5W) Jumped with them, travelling 3 wide no cover throughout, kept on ok considering the circumstances (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W3W5W) 與對手同步躍出，沿途走第三疊，沒有遮擋。在如此形勢下保持尚可走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (3W3W4W) Taken back to last few from a poor draw, commenced move rounding home bend and one of the widest into straight, ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(3W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時開始上前。入直路時走最外疊的馬匹之一。保持佳勢，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened in the final strides. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，直至最後數步轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (5W4W) Tracked pace three wide, keen, brief effort early in home straight, soon weakened.
(Lame in left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(5W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。搶口。直路早段一度發力，瞬即轉弱。
（左後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, made good progress final 200M to take 2nd, no threat to the winner. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初未能望空。最後二百米追前頗多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W) Settled on the rail behind the pacemaker, saved ground to turn, kept on one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路彎前走內欄節省腳程。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off strongly, just beaten by a head, good debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上移出外疊。末段衝刺強勁。僅以一馬頭位之差落敗，首戰表現良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Commenced well, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well until approaching 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持佳勢直至趨近一百米處，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Sat handy, switched out rounding the Turn, made good ground under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。在鞭策下追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Bumped exiting stalls, raced very wide throughout without cover, driven 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W4W) Shifted out at start, raced behind midfield on the outside, very wide turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, driven along top of home straight, no headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Bumped start and unbalanced, sent forward to race prominently, allowed rival to cross near 550M, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞及失去平衡，受催策上前，居前列。接近五百五十米處時讓對手過頭。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, challenged leaders 300m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。三百米處挑戰領先馬匹。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, a bit closer on turn, showed some response early in straight, made contact 200M, steadied near 100M and 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路早段對催策略有反應。二百米處發生觸碰。接近一百米處及五十米處時兩度收慢。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, sat midfield, briefly held up in the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。直路上一度受困。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Box seat, driven along to chase leader 550m out, challenged and every chance from 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。五百五十米處在催策下追趕領放馬。自四百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Raced prominently, brief effort 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 居前列。三百米處一度發力。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Well there, chased leader around home bend and into straight, faded gradually.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 早段居好位。轉直路彎及入直路時追迫領放馬。逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Tracked leader against inside rail, stayed on rail when challenging 200m out, stayed on well to get on top final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。保持走內欄，二百米處展開挑戰。保持佳勢，最後五十米取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat last, no clear run top of the Straight, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居包尾位置。直路初未能望空。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W3W) Soon taken well behind from the widest barrier, commenced move inside the 600M to be 3-wide rounding home bend, kept on at the one pace in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置。六百米處開始發力。轉直路彎時走第三疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, switched for clear run 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。四百米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, hung in in the Straight (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。走勢一般。直路上內閃。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, some headway up rail in home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W1W) 自外檔出閘，墮後。直路上沿欄略為追前。保持走勢，但從未能加速上前挑戰對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W2W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, weakened over the final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W2W) 居前列，走勢一般。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, good headway final bend to chase leaders, sustained headway to challenge 300m out, stayed on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以佳勢上前，追趕領先馬匹。三百米處持續追前以展開挑戰。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to challenge 200m out, share of lead and every chance 100m out, winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 跟隨領先兩駒。二百米處受催策展開挑戰。一百米處並排領先，一度甚具爭勝機會，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W) Began well from gate 10, ridden along to cross to be in 2nd spot, held his ground in the final stages, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，在催策下切入，居第二位。末段保持位置，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide better than midfield, commenced move after passing 500M, 3 wide turning in, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞及失去平衡，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後開始上前。入直路時走第三疊。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on strongly, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段保持強勁走勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W3W) Shortly after the start was tight for galloping room and was then ridden conservatively, responded well under reminders in the home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W3W) 起步後不久受緊迫，繼而留後。直路上對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Bumped out of stalls and crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, effort 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時被碰撞，其後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, lay out throughout the middle stages, angled out 400M, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。中段沿途外閃。四百米處向外移出。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last, never impress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居尾列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W5W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, detached 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W5W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。三百米處被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced in rear, driven along 400m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。四百米處受催策。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W1W) From wide draw taken back to last and was given a waiting ride, 8Ls behind leader 400M, closed off fastest under top weight but couldn't be ridden out final 50M when held up between rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，早段未受催策。四百米處落後領放馬八個馬位。在負頂磅下末段衝刺最快，但最後五十米在對手之間受困時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Restrained to race towards the rear, 4-5Ls off leader 400M, closed off fastest to claim 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 受約束，居後列。四百米處落後領放馬四至五個馬位。末段衝刺最快，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 400m out, ran on well to close on leader but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處開始發力，走外疊。以佳勢追近領放馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W) Obtained a midfield spot along the inside, held up 300M-200M before quickening up strongly to win by dominant margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內疊。三百米處至二百米處之間受困，其後加速強勁，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, obtained a 2-wide position midfield, had every chance turning home but couldn't quicken enough final 200M to challenge for a top three finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後二百米加速不足，未能挑戰三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, switched 600m out, effort 500m out, stayed on but no further impression on front three late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。六百米處轉換跑線。五百米處受催策。保持走勢，但末段未能進一步威脅頭三名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Fast break, made all, pressed by runner-up from 400m out, headed 150m out, fought back to regain the lead close home, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。自四百米處起受亞軍馬匹追迫。一百五十米處被超越。接近終點時反先對手，再次取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速。最後三百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但終點線上不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier settling 3-wide without cover in 5th some 3L off the pace, gradually faded under pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，居第五位，落後領放馬約三個馬位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上在催策下逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Away in line, went forward chasing leaders, raced keenly early and middle stages, couldn't keep up with the pace passing 250M, faded towards the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，上前追趕領先馬匹，早段及中段搶口。跑過二百五十米處時未能跟上步速。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W2W) Ridden from stalls to track leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed by winner 150m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬。直路初率先加速，取得領先。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, angled out to make run 500m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處向外移出取位。衝刺強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (5W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly to make up a lot of ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。以勁勢上前，追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Chased leaders on jumping from draw 1, gave good response turning home, stormed to the lead nearing 100M winning decisively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，追趕領先馬匹。轉直路彎時對催策反應良佳。接近一百米處時以勁勢取得領先，以漂亮姿態勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, angled out rounding the Home Turn, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Raced wide, on heels of leaders entering home straight, unable to sustain effort, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 早段走外疊。入直路時緊隨領先馬匹。其後無以為繼。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Made contact at start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 5 lengths or so back, angled out 450M, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居後列，落後約五個馬位，走外疊。四百五十米處向外移出。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, raced in touch with leaders, driven along 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Raced prominently behind leader, travelling extremely well turning for home, led 250M and was only pushed out to the line. Maintained his unbeaten record with something in hand.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居領放馬之後的前列位置。轉入直路時走勢甚佳。二百五十米處取得領先，末段僅受推策，勝來猶有餘力。保持不敗紀錄。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Average to begin, raced behind midfield on the inside, 6 lengths back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。以勁勢上前，取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Set strong pace, pressed in front, headed top of home straight, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 以快步速領放，在領放下受追迫。直路初被超越。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Showed speed to get across, two lengths clear 600m out, three lengths clear into home straight, weakened quickly and headed by winner 150m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 展現前速，切入內疊。六百米處帶離兩個馬位。入直路時帶離三個馬位。迅速轉弱。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made all, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, in control final 100m, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 領放。二百米處加速帶離對手兩個馬位。最後一百米控制大局。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Jumped well, raced prominently on the middle track, peaked on run approaching 350M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘迅速，居前列，在跑道中央競跑。趨近三百五十米處時未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Soon took up running on the rail setting a sound pace, angled out on straightening and hung on well under pressure in front until swamped final few strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即取得領先，以快步速領放，走內欄。入直路時向外移出。在領放下受催策時保持佳勢，直至最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Made all, showed good speed to get across, kicked 300m out, in control final 100m, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 領放，展現甚快前速以切入。三百米處加速。最後一百米控制大局，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to have uncontested lead, still led by 1-1/2 L rounding the home turn, boxed on well to make top four.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，單騎領放。轉直路彎時仍領先一個半馬位。以佳勢力拼，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, tracked leaders, travelled strongly final bend to lead top of home straight, stayed on, headed by front three close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎走勢強勁，直路初取得領先。保持走勢，接近終點時被三甲馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden to take up running 950M out and rails run 800M out, kicked some 2L clear in front rounding home bend, just held off strong challenges in straight to prevail narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策，九百五十米處取得領先，八百米處移入內欄。轉直路彎時加速帶離約兩個馬位。直路上力拒對手的強勁挑戰，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Caught racing wide in midfield, hung in throughout and responded only fairly in the straight. (Jockey fined for failing to ride out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。沿途內閃，直路上對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點，表現未能令小組滿意而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Held a position behind midfield, swung wide into straight for his challenge but made limited progress only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時移出外疊以展開挑戰，但僅能略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Settled in mid-division, had difficulty obtaining clear running 300M-100M, kept on without threat to first two late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間位置。三百米處至一百米處之間難以望空。末段保持走勢，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (4W2W3W) Sat at the rear, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(4W2W3W) 居後列。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Jumped on terms, settled down 3-wide in midfield 3Ls back, failed to run on in the home straight. (Jockey could offer no explanation for the disappointing performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走第三疊。直路上未能追前。（騎師未能就坐騎令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Awkward start, raced very wide without cover throughout, ridden top of home straight, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 出閘笨拙，沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Blundered badly on jumping with jockey becoming unbalanced and the horse losing ground, settled near rear throughout and couldn't go on turning into the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 躍出時嚴重失蹄，導致騎師失去平衡，失地。沿途居後列。轉入直路時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W3W) Bumped and became unbalanced at the start, settled towards the rear 6Ls away, wide into the straight but couldn't finish off when asked. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞及失去平衡，居後列，落後六個馬位。入直路時走外疊，但在催策下衝刺乏力。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W1W2W) Bumped heavily shortly after start, raced towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer on turn, angled out 400M, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W1W2W) 起步後不久被大力碰撞，居後列，走內疊。直路彎略為追近。四百米處向外移出。衝刺平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W) Travelled 3-wide in midfield, commenced move entering home straight, unable to quicken under pressure and made no further impression inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時開始上前。最後二百米在催策下未能增速，再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W) Wide in mid-field, keen 800m out, headway out wide on bend, sustained headway to challenge top of home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。八百米處搶口。直路彎上前，走外疊。直路初持續上前以展開挑戰。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Tracked leaders, taken wider 600m out, driven along 400m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處被帶出較外疊。四百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, dropped to rear turning into home straight, switched inside early in home straight, bumped 150m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時墮居後列。直路早段移入內疊。一百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Positively ridden out the gate and obtained a leading position as expected, pressed by rival throughout the race, couldn't sustain run final 150m and gave ground late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘後受積極催策，一如預期取得領先。沿途受對手追迫。最後一百五十米後繼無力。末段墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Fast break, made running, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 50m out, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭競跑。直路初加速。五十米處被頭馬超越。僅能保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Crowded after the start, pushed forward to track leader on outside, briefly took over early straight, run ended 150M from home and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 起步後受擠迫，受推策上前，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路初一度領先。一百五十米處無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Soon in front, pressed by rival in the lead, headed nearing 200M before fading final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭，領先時受對手追迫。接近二百米處時被超越。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Ridden forward after moderate beginning to one-out-one-back position about 1000M out, gained slender advantage briefly upon straightening, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，其後受催策上前，約一千米處居第二疊第二位。入直路時一度以短距離領先。迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Raced very wide in mid-field without cover, driven along 500m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W) Dropped back to race in second half of the field, pushed along 550M and brought wide for home, closed off nicely to go 3rd last stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 墮居後半馬群中。五百五十米處受推策。入直路時移出外疊。末段衝刺良佳，最後一步跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, ran on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段以勁勢上前，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Jumped on terms, reserved behind midfield along the fence, 4Ls to make up 400M, did best work late to claim 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，留居中間之後位置，走內欄。四百米處落後四個馬位。末段表現最佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W) Bumped on jumping, held up near the rear 4-5Ls, switched away from fence turning home before closing off well to take 3rd near the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W) 躍出時發生碰撞，留居後列，落後四至五個馬位。轉直路彎時移離內欄。衝刺良佳，接近終點時進佔第三位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Held up last after crowded at start, still in rear top of home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，其後留居包尾位置。直路初仍居後列。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped exiting stalls, tracked leaders, under pressure to chase leaders 600m out, stayed on well, lost second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。其後保持佳勢。接近終點時失去亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, found rail 550M, no daylight early in straight, made minor progress after passing 250M, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處移入內欄。直路早段未能望空。跑過二百五十米處後略為追前。一百米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Bumped exiting stalls, mid division, pushed along wide 500m out, short-lived challenge top of home straight, stayed on for pressure final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。五百米處受推策，走外疊。直路初一度發力挑戰。二百米處在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Bumped at the start, held up towards the rear 6-7Ls off the pace, had some work to do 400M, responded well when asked but was denied clear running from 100M to the finish. Inconclusive run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居後列，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。四百米處仍落後甚遠。對催策反應良佳，但自一百米處起未能望空至終點。未能全力發揮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began well from the one draw but soon dropped to last few on rail, commenced run upon straightening and ran on well to be nearest finish.
(Sustained an abrasion to left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，但瞬即墮居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時開始發力，以佳勢上前。過終點時最為接近。
（左後腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Jumped on terms, settled down midfield 3-4Ls off the pace, kept up the chase on leaders final 300M but was always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後領放馬三至四個馬位。最後三百米保持追趕領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W3W) From draw 12 given a waiting ride, raced keenly near last in a 3-wide position without cover, brought widest for home before making some progress to finish midfield.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，留力候上。居接近包尾位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋，搶口。直路上移出最外疊，其後略為追前，居中間位置過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, restrained in mid-division along the fence, close enough to leaders passing 300M, did best work late and was nearest at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。跑過三百米處時落後領先馬匹不遠。末段表現最佳，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke awkwardly and settled 2nd last after crowded at the start, accelerated only until the last 50m, beaten less than 3L.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，其後受擠迫，居尾二位置。僅在最後五十米始能加速。所負不足三個馬位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped with them, raced at rear, hard ridden from 300M but showed no response, eased final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居後列。自三百米處起受力策，但毫無反應。最後一百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W2W) Disputed led early stages, pressed leader middle stages, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W2W) 早段爭奪領先。中段追迫領放馬。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先。二百米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crossed from wide draw to make running, headed over 200m out, no extra and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。最後一百米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled in midfield along the inside, ran home only fairly from 300M. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內疊。自三百米處起衝刺僅屬一般。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Broke well from a poor draw, gradually settled just off the pace 3-wide without cover, bumped and lost further ground 600M out, weakened from 3.5L 5th into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，逐漸居領放馬稍後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處發生碰撞及進一步失地。入直路時居五位，落後三個半馬位，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Settled ahead of midfield never far off from the pace, brought wide for his run 400M, was steadied 250M but never going the pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置，從未遠離領放馬。四百米處向外移出取位。二百五十米處收慢，但從未能加速上前挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Began well from the widest draw travelling 3-wide without cover in 4th, shifted behind runners 2-wide coming onto home bend, kept on steadily without quickening in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居第四位，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。開始轉直路彎時移至馬群之後，走第二疊。直路上保持穩勢，但未能加速。
